npcdirector.gui.title: NPC administration
npcdirector.gui.summon.tip: Creates a new NPC at your position and opens its settings panel.
npcdirector.gui.name: Name
npcdirector.gui.name.tip: Name shown above the NPC's head and in its messages. Up to 64 characters.
npcdirector.gui.relevance.tip: How important the NPC is for quests. Main adds a star before the name, Indirect a diamond. Click to change.
npcdirector.gui.targetable.tip: When Yes, hostile monsters can hurt this NPC. When No, they ignore it. Click to change.
npcdirector.gui.dialogues.title: Dialogues (%s)
npcdirector.gui.dialogues.empty: No dialogues loaded. Create files in a datapack: data/<namespace>/dialogues/<id>.json
npcdirector.gui.dialogues.tip: Pick the dialogue that opens when talking to the NPC. The first entry (None) disables the dialogue. Dialogues are loaded from datapacks.
npcdirector.gui.apply.tip: Sends the settings of every tab to the server and closes the panel. A skin name you typed but did not apply is sent too.
npcdirector.gui.close.tip: Closes the panel without saving pending changes.
npcdirector.gui.delete.tip: Deletes this NPC. Needs a second click to confirm.
npcdirector.gui.scroll.tip: Scrolls the tab content. The mouse wheel works too.
npcdirector.gui.skin.tip: Name of a Minecraft player (up to 16 characters: letters, digits and _). The server downloads their skin from Mojang. Offline or non-premium names have no skin there: use Import skin from file. On failure it uses the default skin and tells you the cause in chat.
npcdirector.gui.skin_apply.tip: Looks up that player's skin in the background and puts it on the NPC without closing the panel. Type none or leave empty to remove it.
npcdirector.gui.scale.tip: NPC scale: 0.5 is half as tall, 2.0 twice as tall. Use - and + or type the value.
npcdirector.gui.arms.tip: Auto uses the skin's own model. Wide forces 4-pixel arms (Steve), Slim forces 3-pixel arms (Alex). Click to change.
npcdirector.gui.show_name.tip: Shows or hides the floating name above the NPC's head. Click to change.
npcdirector.gui.name_color.tip: Color of the floating name and of the prefix of its messages. Click to cycle through the 16 colors.
npcdirector.gui.slot.head: Helmet
npcdirector.gui.equip.tip: Id of the item the NPC wears in this slot, for example minecraft:iron_helmet. Empty or none leaves it bare. Red when the item does not exist.
npcdirector.gui.use_held.tip: Copies the id of the item in your main hand into this field. It is applied when you press Apply.
npcdirector.gui.look_at.tip: When Yes, the NPC turns its head toward nearby players.
npcdirector.gui.still.tip: When Yes, the NPC does not wander on its own. An assigned patrol keeps working.
npcdirector.gui.invulnerable.tip: When Yes, the NPC takes no damage from any source except /kill and the void.
npcdirector.gui.sit.tip: When Yes, the NPC is shown sitting and does not move or patrol.
npcdirector.gui.speed.tip: Multiplier for the speed at which it walks its patrol path. 1 is normal speed.
npcdirector.gui.greeting.tip: Literal text the NPC sends to a player's chat when they get close. Each player gets it at most once every 20 seconds. Up to 256 characters.
npcdirector.gui.greet_range.tip: How many blocks away a player triggers the greeting.
npcdirector.gui.sound_id.tip: Id of the sound played when a player opens the dialogue. Red when the sound does not exist.
npcdirector.gui.volume.tip: Volume of the sound when the dialogue opens. 0 mutes it, 1 is normal.
npcdirector.gui.pitch.tip: Pitch of the sound: lower is deeper, higher is sharper.
npcdirector.gui.rejected: [NPCDirector] Invalid data (unknown path, dialogue, item or sound), changes rejected
npcdirector.skin.cleared: [NPCDirector] Skin reset to the default one
npcdirector.skin.invalid: [NPCDirector] Invalid skin name: use 1 to 16 letters, digits or _
npcdirector.skin.not_found: [NPCDirector] Player %s does not exist as a Minecraft account (offline or non-premium names have no skin on Mojang servers): using the default skin. You can use Import skin from file
npcdirector.skin.no_texture: [NPCDirector] Player %s has no skin: using the default skin
npcdirector.skin.too_fast: [NPCDirector] Wait a moment before changing the skin again
npcdirector.skin.error: [NPCDirector] Could not get the skin of %s (%s): using the default skin
npcdirector.gui.state.tip: NPC indicator and switch. ON: it patrols, greets and opens its dialogue. OFF: still visible but it does not patrol, greet or open dialogue. Click to toggle, then Apply.
npcdirector.gui.tab.move.tip: Patrol path (selector, assign to this NPC or to all nearby ones, points, loop) and behavior (look at player, still, invulnerable, sitting, speed). Click the active tab again to go back to General.
npcdirector.gui.tab.talk.tip: In-game dialogue editor: what the NPC says, answer buttons, commands and quests.
npcdirector.gui.tab.look.tip: Skin (by name or imported from a file), size, gear, greeting and sounds of the NPC.
npcdirector.gui.tab.out.tip: Dev mode: shows in real time the commands run by buttons, dialogues and the NPC, and whether they succeeded or failed.
npcdirector.gui.sub.look.tip: Skin by player name, size, arm model and visible name.
npcdirector.gui.sub.gear.tip: Items in the hands and armor of the NPC.
npcdirector.gui.sub.sound.tip: Proximity greeting message and sound played when the dialogue opens.
npcdirector.gui.path.current.tip: Path the NPC walks now. Saving the path in this editor assigns it automatically.
npcdirector.gui.path_name.tip: Name used to save the path in the world, next to datapack paths. Lowercase letters, digits and _ only (up to 32).
npcdirector.gui.loop.tip: Yes: when it reaches the last point it starts the circuit again. No: it stays at the final point. This is the loop field of the path JSON.
npcdirector.gui.point.remove.tip: Removes this point from the path.
npcdirector.gui.path.save.tip: Saves the path as world data (mundo:<name>) and assigns it to the NPC. Points that are not set are ignored.
npcdirector.gui.path.empty: Set at least one point before saving.
npcdirector.gui.name.invalid: Invalid name: use a-z, 0-9 and _ (1 to 32).
npcdirector.gui.saving: Sent to the server. Check the chat for the result.
npcdirector.gui.dialogue_name.tip: Name used to save the dialogue in the world, next to datapack dialogues. Lowercase letters, digits and _ only (up to 32).
npcdirector.gui.node.tip: Dialogue node you are editing. The first node is the one that opens when talking to the NPC.
npcdirector.gui.node.add.tip: Creates a new node (up to 16) that buttons can point to.
npcdirector.gui.npc_says.hint: What the NPC says in this node
npcdirector.gui.npc_says.tip: Text the NPC says in this node (up to 8000 characters).
npcdirector.gui.buttons.title: Answer buttons (%s)
npcdirector.gui.buttons.tip: Answers the player can choose. Click a button to edit it.
npcdirector.gui.button_n.tip: Edit the text, commands, next node and quest of this button.
npcdirector.gui.button.add.tip: Adds a new answer button to this node (up to 64) and opens its editor.
npcdirector.gui.button.remove.tip: Deletes this button from the node.
npcdirector.gui.button_text.tip: Text of the answer the player sees (up to 512 characters).
npcdirector.gui.commands.hint: One command per line, e.g. give @p minecraft:apple
npcdirector.gui.commands.tip: Commands run when the button is chosen, one per line, as the player with console permissions. Commands from any installed mod work. Saving commands requires operator permission level 4.
npcdirector.gui.next_node.tip: Id of the node to go to after choosing this button. Empty closes the dialogue.
npcdirector.gui.quest_id.tip: Id of the quest whose state this button sets. Leave empty if it sets none.
npcdirector.gui.quest_state.tip: Quest state set when the button is chosen.
npcdirector.gui.ok.tip: Goes back to the dialogue with the changes of this button.
npcdirector.gui.dialogue.save.tip: Saves the dialogue as world data (mundo:<name>) and assigns it to the NPC.
npcdirector.gui.dialogue.too_big: The dialogue is too large to send (about 30000 bytes maximum).
npcdirector.gui.out.clear.tip: Clears the lines shown in this panel.
npcdirector.gui.out.dev_off: Dev mode is off. Type /npcdirector mode dev and reopen this tab to see commands in real time.
npcdirector.gui.editor_rejected: [NPCDirector] The server refused to save the %s: invalid data or no permission (see the output panel or the log)
npcdirector.gui.need_level4: [NPCDirector] Saving commands in a dialogue requires operator permission level 4
npcdirector.msg.not_npc: [NPCDirector] The target is not an NPC of this mod
npcdirector.msg.skin.invalid_name: [NPCDirector] Invalid skin name (1 to 16 characters A-Z a-z 0-9 _)
npcdirector.msg.no_npc_near: [NPCDirector] No NPC in sight within 6 blocks
npcdirector.msg.npc.name: [NPCDirector] Name: %s
npcdirector.msg.dev_required: [NPCDirector] The edit panel is only available in developer mode. Use /npcdirector mode dev
npcdirector.gui.point.invalid: Invalid coordinates: use whole numbers for X, Y and Z (X and Z up to 30000000, Y from -2048 to 4096).
npcdirector.gui.point.coord.tip: Whole number. You can paste three numbers in any box (12 64 -30, 12, 64, -30 or 12/64/-30, also the F3 line) and they are split into X, Y and Z.
npcdirector.gui.lang.tip: Language of this panel, saved on this computer. Auto follows the game language; Español and English force it. Current: %s. Click to change.
npcdirector.gui.path.prev.tip: Previous path in the list (paths from datapacks and paths saved in the world). The first entry is None.
npcdirector.gui.path.select.tip: Path selected in the list. Use the buttons below to assign it. Click here to go to the next one.
npcdirector.gui.path.assign_this.tip: Gives the selected path to this NPC right now, without pressing Apply. None removes its patrol.
npcdirector.gui.path.assign_radius.tip: Gives the selected path to every NPC of this mod within %s blocks of you. The server checks operator, developer mode, distance and a limit of 32 NPCs, and only touches NPCs of this mod.
npcdirector.gui.point.add_here.tip: Adds a point at your current position at the end of the path (up to 32). You can edit its numbers afterwards.
npcdirector.gui.point.none: No points yet. Stand where you want the first one and press Add point here.
npcdirector.gui.behavior.title: Behavior
npcdirector.gui.behavior.tip: Look at player, stay still, invulnerable, sitting pose and patrol speed of this NPC.
npcdirector.gui.skin_import.tip: Opens your file picker to choose a PNG skin (64x64 or 64x32, up to 16 KB). The server checks it, stores it with the NPC and sends it to the players who see it. It replaces the skin by name.
npcdirector.gui.skin_import.opening: Choose the PNG file in the window that opened...
npcdirector.gui.skin_import.too_big: The file is larger than 16 KB.
npcdirector.gui.skin_import.not_png: That file is not a valid PNG.
npcdirector.gui.skin_import.bad_size: The skin must be 64x64 or 64x32 pixels.
npcdirector.gui.skin_import.sent: Skin %s sent. Check the chat for the result.
npcdirector.gui.path_assigned_all: [NPCDirector] Path %s assigned to %s NPCs within %s blocks
npcdirector.gui.path_too_many: [NPCDirector] Refused: %s NPCs within %s blocks (limit %s). Nothing changed
npcdirector.skin.import.ok: [NPCDirector] Custom skin imported and applied (%s bytes)
npcdirector.skin.import.too_big: [NPCDirector] Skin file rejected: it is larger than 16 KB
npcdirector.skin.import.corrupt: [NPCDirector] Skin file rejected: it is not a valid PNG
npcdirector.skin.import.bad_size: [NPCDirector] Skin file rejected: it must be 64x64 or 64x32 pixels
npcdirector.skin.import.too_fast: [NPCDirector] Wait a moment before importing another skin
npcdirector.skin.import.incomplete: [NPCDirector] Skin import timed out, try again
npcdirector.skin.network: [NPCDirector] No connection to Mojang servers for the skin of %s (%s). Check the internet access or firewall of the server, or use Import skin from file
npcdirector.skin.rate_limited: [NPCDirector] Mojang is limiting skin requests for %s (%s). Wait about a minute and press Apply skin again, or use Import skin from file
